Look closely at this ancient stone carving… 👀🪨

At first glance, it almost looks as though one part of the sculpture is moving or rotating inside another part of the same stone. That is what makes this carving so fascinating.

There are no visible joints, no modern machinery, and no obvious way to understand how such an intricate form could have been shaped with such precision. 🛕✨
